approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: A stronger email Subject currently inherits an RFI role or Submittal status found after a different same-type identifier in the current body.
Keep Subject/body/filename routing precedence, but scope roles and statuses to the selected identifier and label each explicit body section with its own exact identifier.
Reuse deterministic regular expressions and existing evidence locators; add no dependency, semantic inference, mailbox access or model call.
Offline parser and API regressions, specification sync and every bounded task context pack passed before completion.
title: Workflow field scope by identifier
objective: Prevent an RFI role or Submittal status from crossing into a different exact identifier while preserving routing precedence and giving each explicit email or text section an accurate evidence locator.
